paragraphs: Rabbi Abba bar Zutra said in Rabbi Chanina’s name. He was Rabbi Yochanan’s interpreter, Jerusalem Talmud, Nedarim, chapter 10, halakhah 10, cited in Tosafot Ran to Nedarim, chapter 1, 8b; also chapter Hacholetz and Niddah, first chapter, halakhah 4. Midrash Shmuel, chapter 15: in Shmuel’s name. Rabbi Ze'ira, Rabbi Chanina in Rabbi’s name (Jerusalem Talmud, Avodah Zarah, chapter 2); in Rabbi Chiyya Ruba’s name there. Rabbi Abba bar Mammal and Rabbi Abba bar Zavda were in his time. He said in Rabbi Chanina’s name, Avodah Zarah 28b. Chapter Hashole'ach: Rava bar Zutra; perhaps they are one.
